_note: Shared NucleoOS vocabulary — available in EVERY app under the namespace. Keep keys aligned with core.it.json (the i18n gate checks this).
name: Name
cap_secure_no: the page is plain http: the browser switches advanced features off
cap_f16_no: the 32-bit model builds are used, slightly larger
cap_fix_open: Open (paste it into the address bar):
cap_fix_enable: Set it to “Enabled” and press “Relaunch”: the browser reopens and NucleoOS gets every feature.
cap_ff_pref: Find the setting and add the device's address:
cap_use_chromium: This browser can't unlock them for an http address. Open NucleoOS in an up-to-date Chrome or Edge.
cap_tip_unlocks: The same setting also unlocks offline model storage, offline operation and the browser's built-in AI.
cap_tip_ip: It applies to this exact address: if the device's IP changes you must repeat it. Best to reserve its IP in your router (DHCP).
cap_fix_browser: This browser has no WebGPU. Use an up-to-date Chrome or Edge (Android too); Firefox and Safari have it only in their newest versions.
cap_fix_blocked: WebGPU is there but the GPU can't be used: turn on hardware acceleration in the browser settings and check chrome://gpu. Meanwhile you can use the CPU models.
cap_fix_nof16: The GPU doesn't support shader-f16: NucleoOS automatically uses the 32-bit model builds.
cap_verify_still: Not on yet — if you just changed the setting, press “Relaunch” in the browser.
lai_why: {server} is running on this computer, but it only accepts pages opened from here. NucleoOS comes from {origin} (the device), so it is refused. Allow that address once:
lai_win_quit: Quit Ollama: right-click its icon next to the clock → Quit.
lai_win_start: Start Ollama again from the Start menu.
lai_mac_restart: Quit Ollama from the menu bar and open it again.
lai_mac_reboot: launchctl lasts until the Mac restarts: run the command again after a reboot.
lai_linux_add: Add these lines, then save and exit:
lai_keep: Already have OLLAMA_ORIGINS for another address? Keep it and add this one after a comma.
lai_lms_cli: Start the LM Studio server with CORS on:
lai_lms_gui: Or in the app: Developer → server settings → Enable CORS.
lai_generic: In {server}'s settings turn CORS on (or allow the origin {origin}), then restart the server.
lai_other: {server} runs on a computer: open NucleoOS in that computer's browser, or set OLLAMA_ORIGINS={origin} there.
lai_still: Still refused. Did you restart {server} after the change?
lai_down: {server} does not answer: is it running?
lai_hint: {server} is running on this computer but refuses NucleoOS.
zip_err_not_zip: This is not a ZIP archive.
zip_err_encrypted: The archive is password-protected and cannot be opened here.
zip_err_unsupported: The archive uses an unsupported compression method.
zip_err_bomb: The archive looks malicious (it would expand abnormally) and was refused.
zip_err_too_large: The archive is too large to extract here.
zip_err_too_many: The archive contains too many items.
zip_err_bad_name: A name in the archive is not valid.
zip_err_not_found: File not found in the archive.
zip_err_exists: A file with this name already exists.
zip_err_not_archive: This is not a recognised archive.
zip_err_password: The archive is protected: the right password is needed.
zip_err_no_engine: This browser cannot open this kind of archive.
zip_password_new: Password for the new ZIP archive (AES-256 encryption):
fs_reason_r2_locked: The cloud archive is locked in this browser: unlock it (or create it) in Settings.
fs_reason_r2_not_configured: The cloud archive is not configured on this server.
fs_reason_r2_offline: The cloud archive cannot be reached right now.
fs_reason_r2_tampered: A piece of the cloud archive was tampered with: reading stopped.
myapps_template: No model is available right now, so I prepared the basic app: **{name}**. With a model on in Settings › AI I write the app you ask for.
myapps_template_failed: The model did not give a usable answer, so I prepared the basic app: **{name}**. You can try again shortly.
myapps_new: If you install it, it goes in Start, under **{category}**.
myapps_update: **{name}** is already installed (version {from}): installing it makes it version {to}.
myapps_safety: It stays in your personal folder and runs isolated: no network, no access to your files or other apps, and you can remove it any time. This is the code:
myapps_refused: I had the model write the app, but I will not install it: {reasons}. The apps I install may not do that. Try asking for a simpler one.
myapps_r_eval: it runs code built on the fly
myapps_r_parent: it talks to the OS without NucleoApp
myapps_r_remote: it loads things from the internet
myapps_r_element: it embeds other pages or objects
myapps_r_strings: it has texts without a translation
myapps_r_syntax: it has an error in its code
myapps_remove_ask: Remove **{name}**? It goes to the Recycle Bin, where you can restore it.
